needs_review: PARKED IN drafts/ ON PURPOSE: this spec is NOT registrable. Every notion tool post-processes its response with COMPUTED fields that Connector Spec v1 pick cannot express (rich-text plain_text joins, per-property-type switches, the dynamic blocks[b.type].rich_text key). Promoting it would silently change what agents receive.
create_page is omitted entirely: its request body is computed (per-value-type property wrapping plus the Name title wrapper), so not even its request ports.

search: request parity holds only when filter_type is supplied. Without it the legacy module omits the filter key; the runtime keeps {"property":"object"} because only the templated inner value drops.
Evidence for what DOES port: test/connectorNotionParity.test.js drives module and runtime side by side over the same mocked fetch.
